body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Dcube presented a HD DivX Player ''Mvision'' at KES 2006. This product plays DVD files (iso, vib, and ifo) from a hard disk as well as MP3, OGG, WMA music files in addition to movies. It features 5.1 channel sound and USB 2.0 Interface for external storage. It also has a photo slide show function.
